summary: The manuscript presents a rigorous machine-checked formalization and exact-rational certificate auditor for the algebraic, combinatorial, and barrier-closure core of Koval and Peres's high-dimensional tower transition in majority bootstrap percolation. Featuring an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel and a four-mode exact-Q Python auditor validated against 16 canonical certificates and 60 adversarial test cases, the work establishes a new standard for verified combinatorial probability.
weaknesses: Scope is intentionally restricted to finite algebraic, barrier, and tail cores, leaving infinite-limit probabilistic couplings for future work.
